context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 tested logo display and membership logs features. Backend: GET /api/members/{member_id}/membership-logs returns array of membership change logs sorted by created_at desc. Each log has: id, type, member_id, member_name, gym_id, previous_end_date, new_end_date, comment, changed_by, changed_by_role, created_at. Frontend: AdminLayout.js (lines 90-92) computes gymLogoUrl with startsWith('/') check. PWALayout.js (line 69) has same logic. AdminMembers.js (lines 1252-1273) shows 'Historial de cambios' section in edit expiration modal. Gyms in test environment don't have logo_url set, so fallback QrCode icon displays correctly.
